title: Live v2.4 04 — The Sun Idol
description: A vault where the Sun Idol rests on a pressure plate. (v2.4 plan 04 live gates: idol_taken gates the way into the next anchor and reads evidence only from lines the player did not write; the altar checkpoint opts into the player-attempts clause; door_open is an ordinary quality so each reply schedules a cadence read.)

qualities.rubric: Does the player now hold the Sun Idol in their hands? True only once the idol is actually in hand.

checkpoints.objective: The party stands before the Sun Idol on its altar.
checkpoints.guidance: The Sun Idol rests on a pressure plate; the stone shifts if it is lifted carelessly.

checkpoints.objective: The party flees the collapsing vault with the idol.
